decision: Record that the REV4 section 9.3 memory-gate deviation tracked as blocker B7 has no subject in the exact D5 training plan. D5 trains on the frozen biological substrate only; it constructs, reads without authorisation, or substitutes no randomized graph, so the deviation from the section 9.3 gate cannot be triggered, accepted, resolved or weakened by it. This record preserves G3 status deviation_recorded and gate_weakened false unchanged, keeps all sixteen randomized graph files and their sixteen certificates unchanged, keeps REV4 section 9.3 itself unchanged, and confirms that every graph-dependent stage remains blocked. It authorises no training, no graph construction, no graph access and no graph-dependent stage.

owner_decisions.text: Record that B7 has no subject in the D5 plan: the six authorised F and Fbeta training runs use the frozen biological substrate and construct, read or substitute no randomized graph. The section 9.3 memory gate governs BANC-scale graph randomisation, not a constant biological-substrate training run.

Preserve the G3 compliance record exactly: status = deviation_recorded, gate_weakened = false, REV4 section 9.3 unchanged. D6 neither accepts nor resolves the deviation and does not re-run the randomised construction.

Preserve all sixteen randomized graph files and all sixteen certificates unchanged. Their recorded SHA-256 digests remain the authority. D6 does not regenerate, read, compare against or replace any graph.

Confirm every graph-dependent stage remains blocked. D6 grants no exemption to any graph-dependent stage and is non-inheritable: it is scoped only to the exact D5 plan and does not carry to Pilot 2-C, the confirmatory campaign or any other stage beyond the one already covered by D3.
